jei.setting.give.tooltip: In creative, a click on the item list gives the item (right click: a stack). In survival it opens its recipes.
jei.setting.hints.tooltip: Item tooltips say how many recipes make and use the item (R and U).
jei.setting.centred_search.tooltip: JEI's centred search bar: under the screen's window when there is room, else under the item list.
